# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/policy_decisions/work.py` | 按输入顺序重放策略变更，为每个 request 原位置生成授权布尔值。 | `components/policy_decisions/result.json` |
| `components/service_routes/work.py` | 按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。 | `components/service_routes/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh
python -B component_runtime.py check policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py run policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py check service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py run service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py join
python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json
python -B public_check.py
```

默认组件样例与整题公开输入对应。处理另一个输入文件时，请在两个 run 命令和 join 命令上使用相同的 `--input PATH`。每次独立实验使用自己的题目工作区。组件样例仅供开发自检，正式评分继续使用整题的冻结用例。

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/policy_decisions/work.py` | 按输入顺序重放策略变更，为每个 request 原位置生成授权布尔值。 | `components/policy_decisions/result.json` |
| `components/service_routes/work.py` | 按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。 | `components/service_routes/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh
python -B component_runtime.py check policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py run policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py check service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py run service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py join
python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json
python -B public_check.py
```

默认组件样例与整题公开输入对应。处理另一个输入文件时，请在两个 run 命令和 join 命令上使用相同的 `--input PATH`。每次独立实验使用自己的题目工作区。组件样例仅供开发自检，正式评分继续使用整题的冻结用例。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

def compute(payload):
    """按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。"""
    clusters = payload["clusters"]
    events = payload["events"]
    result = {}
    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get("op") != "request":
            continue
        cluster = clusters.get(event["cluster"], {})
        mode = cluster.get("mode", "remote")
        services = cluster.get("services", {})
        available = bool(services.get(event["service"], False))
        result[str(idx)] = [mode, available]
    return result

# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/policy_decisions/work.py` | 按输入顺序重放策略变更，为每个 request 原位置生成授权布尔值。 | `components/policy_decisions/result.json` |
| `components/service_routes/work.py` | 按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。 | `components/service_routes/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh
python -B component_runtime.py check policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py run policy_decisions
python -B component_runtime.py check service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py run service_routes
python -B component_runtime.py join
python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json
python -B public_check.py
```

默认组件样例与整题公开输入对应。处理另一个输入文件时，请在两个 run 命令和 join 命令上使用相同的 `--input PATH`。每次独立实验使用自己的题目工作区。组件样例仅供开发自检，正式评分继续使用整题的冻结用例。

# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

## 交付与公开检查

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

## 可独立运行的业务文件

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| 实现文件 | 返回值约定 | 独占的结果文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `components/policy_decisions/work.py` | 按输入顺序重放策略变更，为每个 request 原位置生成授权布尔值。 | `components/policy_decisions/result.json` |
| `components/service_routes/work.py` | 按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。 | `components/service_routes/result.json` |

每个组件目录已有独立公开输入 `input.json`、样例结果 `expected.json` 及可覆写的 `result.json`。分别运行组件可落盘，汇总命令只读取两份已有结果。最终交付路径 `outputs/result.json` 也已预建。

```sh

python -B component_runtime.py run policy_decisions

python -B component_runtime.py run service_routes

python -B run_all.py --input public_input.json --output outputs/result.json

```

# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    ttl = payload["ttl"]
    events = payload["events"]

    # left: policy_decisions -> {str(index): bool} for request events
    # right: service_routes -> {str(index): [mode, available]} for request events

    replies = []
    authorizer_calls = 0
    service_lookups = 0
    remote_routes = 0
    certificates_issued = 0
    cert_counter = 0
    cache = {}  # (user, cluster, service) -> {"credential": ..., "expires": ...}

    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get("op") != "request":
            continue
        key = str(idx)
        authorized = left.get(key, False)

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

    authorizer_calls = 0

    remote_routes = 0
    certificates_issued = 0
    cert_counter = 0
    cache = {}  # (user, cluster, service) -> {"credential": ..., "expires": ...}

    for idx, event in enumerate(events):

            continue
        key = str(idx)
        authorized = left.get(key, False)
        authorizer_calls += 1
        if not authorized:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "denied"})
            continue

        mode, available = right.get(key, ["remote", False])
        service_lookups += 1
        if not available:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "not_found"})
            continue

        now = event["time"]
        if mode == "local":
            replies.append({
                "id": event["id"],
                "status": "ok",
                "credential": "local",
                "route": "local",

            continue

        # remote

        ck = (event["user"], event["cluster"], event["service"])

        if entry is not None and entry["expires"] > now:
            credential = entry["credential"]
        else:
            # expired or missing -> issue new certificate
            cert_counter += 1

            credential = "cert-%d" % cert_counter
            cache[ck] = {"credential": credential, "expires": now + ttl}
        replies.append({
            "id": event["id"],
            "status": "ok",
            "credential": credential,
            "route": "reverse_tunnel",
        })

    cache_list = [
        {
            "user": ck[0],
            "cluster": ck[1],
            "service": ck[2],
            "credential": entry["credential"],
            "expires": entry["expires"],
        }
        for ck, entry in sorted(cache.items())
    ]

    return {
        "replies": replies,
        "authorizer_calls": authorizer_calls,
        "service_lookups": service_lookups,
        "remote_routes": remote_routes,
        "certificates_issued": certificates_issued,
        "cache": cache_list,
    }

  atol=tol.get('atol',0) if isinstance(tol,dict) else tol

 if isinstance(a,list) and isinstance(b,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return type(a)==type(b) and a==b
assert equal(transform(p),expected)

def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    ttl = payload["ttl"]
    events = payload["events"]

    # left: policy_decisions -> {str(index): bool} for request events
    # right: service_routes -> {str(index): [mode, available]} for request events

    replies = []
    authorizer_calls = 0
    service_lookups = 0
    remote_routes = 0
    certificates_issued = 0
    cert_counter = 0
    cache = {}  # (user, cluster, service) -> {"credential": ..., "expires": ...}

    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get("op") != "request":
            continue
        key = str(idx)
        authorized = left.get(key, False)
        authorizer_calls += 1
        if not authorized:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "denied"})
            continue

        mode, available = right.get(key, ["remote", False])
        service_lookups += 1
        if not available:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "not_found"})
            continue

        now = event["time"]
        if mode == "local":
            replies.append({
                "id": event["id"],
                "status": "ok",
                "credential": "local",
                "route": "local",
            })
            continue

        # remote
        remote_routes += 1
        ck = (event["user"], event["cluster"], event["service"])
        entry = cache.get(ck)
        if entry is not None and entry["expires"] > now:
            credential = entry["credential"]
        else:
            # expired or missing -> issue new certificate
            cert_counter += 1
            certificates_issued += 1
            credential = "cert-%d" % cert_counter
            cache[ck] = {"credential": credential, "expires": now + ttl}
        replies.append({
            "id": event["id"],
            "status": "ok",
            "credential": credential,
            "route": "reverse_tunnel",
        })

    cache_list = [
        {
            "user": ck[0],
            "cluster": ck[1],
            "service": ck[2],
            "credential": entry["credential"],
            "expires": entry["expires"],
        }
        for ck, entry in sorted(cache.items())
    ]

    return {
        "replies": replies,
        "authorizer_calls": authorizer_calls,
        "service_lookups": service_lookups,
        "remote_routes": remote_routes,
        "certificates_issued": certificates_issued,
        "cache": cache_list,
    }

def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    ttl = payload["ttl"]
    events = payload["events"]

    # left: policy_decisions -> {str(index): bool} for request events
    # right: service_routes -> {str(index): [mode, available]} for request events

    replies = []
    authorizer_calls = 0
    service_lookups = 0
    remote_routes = 0
    certificates_issued = 0
    cert_counter = 0
    cache = {}  # (user, cluster, service) -> {"credential": ..., "expires": ...}

    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get("op") != "request":
            continue
        key = str(idx)
        authorized = left.get(key, False)
        authorizer_calls += 1
        if not authorized:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "denied"})
            continue

        mode, available = right.get(key, ["remote", False])
        service_lookups += 1
        if not available:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "not_found"})
            continue

        now = event["time"]
        if mode == "local":
            replies.append({
                "id": event["id"],
                "status": "ok",
                "credential": "local",
                "route": "local",
            })
            continue

        # remote
        remote_routes += 1
        ck = (event["user"], event["cluster"], event["service"])
        entry = cache.get(ck)
        if entry is not None and entry["expires"] > now:
            credential = entry["credential"]
        else:
            # expired or missing -> issue new certificate
            cert_counter += 1
            certificates_issued += 1
            credential = "cert-%d" % cert_counter
            cache[ck] = {"credential": credential, "expires": now + ttl}
        replies.append({
            "id": event["id"],
            "status": "ok",
            "credential": credential,
            "route": "reverse_tunnel",
        })

    cache_list = [
        {
            "user": ck[0],
            "cluster": ck[1],
            "service": ck[2],
            "credential": entry["credential"],
            "expires": entry["expires"],
        }
        for ck, entry in sorted(cache.items())
    ]

    return {
        "replies": replies,
        "authorizer_calls": authorizer_calls,
        "service_lookups": service_lookups,
        "remote_routes": remote_routes,
        "certificates_issued": certificates_issued,
        "cache": cache_list,
    }

# C067 逐请求授权与临时凭据缓存

实现一个可独立导入和命令行运行的组件。核心接口`transform(payload)`返回下述JSON结果，不修改输入对象。`load_payload(input_path)`读取UTF8 JSON并返回对象；`build_component(input_path,output_path)`独立读取、计算并将结果写入UTF8 JSON，返回相同结果。三个入口都须在无旧产物的全新目录工作。

## 公开业务契约

输入ttl为正整数，clusters映射cluster到mode(local/remote)与services布尔可用表；policies映射user到允许规则列表，每条cluster/verb必须精确匹配，service可省略或为`*`以允许任一服务。events按非递减time排列，同刻按数组顺序。policy事件替换指定user的allow列表；service事件更新可用性；request事件给id/user/cluster/service/verb。

每个request必须重新授权，未允许则status=denied，不查服务/不签发凭据。允许后必须先查当前service，查不到则not_found，不签发也不从旧缓存绕过查找。local直接使用local凭据，不建缓存。remote每次解析reverse_tunnel路由；凭据缓存只保存以(user,cluster,service)为键的临时证书，不能保存授权结论或完整会话。到期条件expires<=now；清理发生在成功找到remote服务后的缓存访问。缓存miss按全局顺序签发cert-1、cert-2等，expires=now+ttl；hit不延期。

输出replies保持request顺序，拒绝仅有id/status；成功另有credential(local或cert-N)、route(local或reverse_tunnel)。计数authorizer_calls、service_lookups、remote_routes、certificates_issued及最终cache按user/cluster/service字典序排列，每项含键与credential/expires。

在`solution.py`实现三个入口；可自行新增业务文件。`python run_all.py --check`运行小型公开例。`python run_all.py --input public_input.json --output output.json`生成产物。运行不依赖作者目录、既有output、网络或隐藏服务；不得修改run_all.py、public_input.json和public_expected.json。验收覆盖本文正常输入域与完整交付，不要求额外NaN/Infinity防御、错误文本、代码风格或未公开兼容范围。

本版已接好 `solution.py` 的三个公开入口。实现下列两个组件的 `compute(payload)` 和工作区根目录 `integration.py` 的 `combine(payload, left, right)`。left、right 按表中两行的顺序对应，两项工作可同时开展。整合端消费组件的业务值，并完成题面其余计算。

| `components/service_routes/work.py` | 按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。 | `components/service_routes/result.json` |

def combine(payload, left, right):
    """Combine the two component JSON values under the business contract in TASK.md."""
    ttl = payload["ttl"]
    events = payload["events"]

    # left: policy_decisions -> {str(index): bool} for request events
    # right: service_routes -> {str(index): [mode, available]} for request events

    replies = []
    authorizer_calls = 0
    service_lookups = 0
    remote_routes = 0
    certificates_issued = 0
    cert_counter = 0
    cache = {}  # (user, cluster, service) -> {"credential": ..., "expires": ...}

    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        if event.get("op") != "request":
            continue
        key = str(idx)
        authorized = left.get(key, False)
        authorizer_calls += 1
        if not authorized:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "denied"})
            continue

        mode, available = right.get(key, ["remote", False])
        service_lookups += 1
        if not available:
            replies.append({"id": event["id"], "status": "not_found"})
            continue

        now = event["time"]
        if mode == "local":
            replies.append({
                "id": event["id"],
                "status": "ok",
                "credential": "local",
                "route": "local",
            })
            continue

        # remote
        remote_routes += 1
        ck = (event["user"], event["cluster"], event["service"])
        entry = cache.get(ck)
        if entry is not None and entry["expires"] > now:
            credential = entry["credential"]
        else:
            # expired or missing -> issue new certificate
            cert_counter += 1
            certificates_issued += 1
            credential = "cert-%d" % cert_counter
            cache[ck] = {"credential": credential, "expires": now + ttl}
        replies.append({
            "id": event["id"],
            "status": "ok",
            "credential": credential,
            "route": "reverse_tunnel",
        })

    cache_list = [
        {
            "user": ck[0],
            "cluster": ck[1],
            "service": ck[2],
            "credential": entry["credential"],
            "expires": entry["expires"],
        }
        for ck, entry in sorted(cache.items())
    ]

    return {
        "replies": replies,
        "authorizer_calls": authorizer_calls,
        "service_lookups": service_lookups,
        "remote_routes": remote_routes,
        "certificates_issued": certificates_issued,
        "cache": cache_list,
    }

import unittest

from solution import transform


class TestTransformContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_denied_request_no_service_lookup(self):
        # A request not allowed must be denied without service lookup or cert.
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "write"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "denied"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["authorizer_calls"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["service_lookups"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["remote_routes"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_not_found_no_certificate(self):
        # Allowed but service unavailable -> not_found, no cert issued.
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": False}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "not_found"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["service_lookups"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_local_route_no_cache(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "local", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{
            "id": "r1", "status": "ok", "credential": "local", "route": "local"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_cache_expiry_issues_new_cert(self):
        # ttl=2, requests at time 0 and time 2 -> expires<=now triggers new cert.
        payload = {
            "ttl": 2,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r2", "time": 2, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"][0]["credential"], "cert-1")
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"][1]["credential"], "cert-2")
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(out["cache"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"][0]["credential"], "cert-2")
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"][0]["expires"], 4)

    def test_policy_event_replaces_allow_list(self):
        # policy event replaces the user's allow list entirely.
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "local", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "policy", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "allow": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "write"}]},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 1, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "denied"}])

    def test_service_event_updates_availability(self):
        # service event toggles availability off before the request.
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "service", "time": 0, "cluster": "c", "service": "s",
                 "available": False},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 1, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "not_found"}])

    def test_transform_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        import copy
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        before = copy.deepcopy(payload)
        transform(payload)
        self.assertEqual(payload, before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def compute(payload):
    """按事件位置返回请求当时的 [集群模式,服务是否可用]；合并端负责授权优先和实际计数。"""
    clusters = payload["clusters"]
    events = payload["events"]
    result = {}
    services_state = {}
    for idx, event in enumerate(events):
        op = event.get("op")
        if op == "service":
            cluster = event.get("cluster")
            service = event.get("service")
            available = event.get("available", False)
            services_state.setdefault(cluster, {})[service] = bool(available)
            continue
        if op != "request":
            continue
        cluster = clusters.get(event["cluster"], {})
        mode = cluster.get("mode", "remote")
        services = cluster.get("services", {})
        # service events may have updated availability
        updated = services_state.get(event["cluster"], {}).get(event["service"])
        if updated is None:
            available = bool(services.get(event["service"], False))
        else:
            available = updated
        result[str(idx)] = [mode, available]
    return result

import unittest


class TestTransformContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def _call(self, payload):
        return call_candidate("solution.py", "transform", args=[payload])

    def test_denied_request_no_service_lookup(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "write"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "denied"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["authorizer_calls"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["service_lookups"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["remote_routes"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_not_found_no_certificate(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": False}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "not_found"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["service_lookups"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_local_route_no_cache(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "local", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{
            "id": "r1", "status": "ok", "credential": "local", "route": "local"}])
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"], [])

    def test_cache_expiry_issues_new_cert(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 2,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r2", "time": 2, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"][0]["credential"], "cert-1")
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"][1]["credential"], "cert-2")
        self.assertEqual(out["certificates_issued"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(out["cache"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"][0]["credential"], "cert-2")
        self.assertEqual(out["cache"][0]["expires"], 4)

    def test_policy_event_replaces_allow_list(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "local", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "policy", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "allow": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "write"}]},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 1, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "denied"}])

    def test_service_event_updates_availability(self):
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "service", "time": 0, "cluster": "c", "service": "s",
                 "available": False},
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 1, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        out = self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(out["replies"], [{"id": "r1", "status": "not_found"}])

    def test_transform_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        import copy
        payload = {
            "ttl": 5,
            "clusters": {"c": {"mode": "remote", "services": {"s": True}}},
            "policies": {"u": [{"cluster": "c", "verb": "read"}]},
            "events": [
                {"op": "request", "id": "r1", "time": 0, "user": "u",
                 "cluster": "c", "service": "s", "verb": "read"},
            ],
        }
        before = copy.deepcopy(payload)
        self._call(payload)
        self.assertEqual(payload, before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
